title: Jev
description: Dangerous-command gate on agent machines and the C3 label comparison against regex. Owners only.
ownerOnly: Only owners can view this page
ownerOnlyHint: Ask a company owner to open the Jev page.
loadFailed: Could not load the Jev settings

settings.enabledHint: When off, machines do not call Jev and block nothing.
settings.serverShadowHint: The server compares Jev's label with regex for finished runs and runtime failures. Logging only, never changes outcomes.

gateModeHint.shadow: Jev scores and logs, blocks nothing.
gateModeHint.enforce: Commands Jev denies are really blocked on the machine.

settings.thresholdHint: From {{min}} to {{max}}. Lower confidence is escalated to a human.
settings.timeoutHint: From {{min}} to {{max}} ms. On timeout the command falls back to the old rules.

error.model: Model must look like typesafe/jev-… (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore).
error.threshold: Threshold must be a number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
error.timeout: Timeout must be an integer from {{min}} to {{max}} ms.

settings.saved: Settings saved, version {{version}}. Machines pick it up on their next pull.

enforceConfirm.title: Switch to Enforce?
enforceConfirm.body: Once saved, commands Jev denies are really blocked on every machine with Jev on. Watching Log only for a while first is wise.

key.label: New key
key.hint: The key is sent to the server once and stored as a secret; it is never shown again, only its fingerprint.

result.deleted: Key deleted. Machines remove it from Keychain on their next pull.
result.testFailed: Key saved but the test failed

deleteConfirm.title: Delete the OpenRouter key?
deleteConfirm.body: Jev stops on every machine until a new key is saved.

key.needKey: Paste the key into the field above first.

machines.empty: No machine has pulled the settings yet
machines.emptyHint: Machines show up here after their first pull.
machines.hint: A machine reports its applied version on its next pull, so it can lag up to a minute after you save.

stats.emptyHint: Stats appear once machines send gate events.
stats.notCalled: Not counted as calls: {{skipped}} Jev skips (enough background processes), Mac dropped {{dropped}} unsent log lines.

events.emptyHint: Deny or escalate cases sent by machines show up here.
